title: ESRI (ArcGIS REST) Provider
description: ArcGIS REST tile services (MapServer, TileServer, ImageServer). Use for ESRI/Esri-hosted datasets.

body.url: ArcGIS REST service endpoint, e.g. 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/arcgis/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer'. Do NOT append /tile/{z}/{y}/{x} — the plugin does that.

params.transparent: Boolean, default false for basemaps, true for overlays.

examples.description: World Imagery basemap from ArcGIS Online
ArcGIS MapServer with specific layers visible

notes: The URL should be the service root (e.g. .../MapServer) not a tile URL.
ArcGIS Online services often require authentication — check if the service is public.
For tiled cache services, the plugin uses ol/source/TileArcGISRest which handles tile URLs automatically.
